prompts.question: Is the company listed in the ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) public register as a regulated or approved financial firm?
prompts.why_it_matters: FSRA registration is the licence to act as a financial firm in ADGM, so a missing or revoked entry signals an unlicensed operator.

source.name: ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) Register

prompts.how_to_query: Open the ADGM public registers page, choose the FSRA register and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A register entry matches the company name and shows a licence status with permitted financial activities.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the FSRA register returns no entry for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register search is unavailable or the company name is too generic to match a single entry.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) partner and ecosystem directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: An ADIO listing signals government-backed partnership or incentive status that adds credibility to the company's claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the ADIO ecosystem directory and look for the company name among the listed partners and ventures.
prompts.found_when: The company has a listing in the ADIO ecosystem directory.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean scan of the directory shows no listing under the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory cannot be searched or filtered, or the name is too common to identify a single listing.

prompts.question: Has Al Bayan (البيان) business coverage mentioned the company in connection with agreements, disputes or announcements?
prompts.why_it_matters: Arabic-language press surfaces local commercial agreements and legal disputes that English outlets often miss.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Al Bayan site search with the company name, trying the Arabic form of the name as well.
prompts.found_when: At least one Al Bayan article names the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The Al Bayan search returns no article naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns unrelated articles because the name is too common, or the search page will not load.

prompts.question: Has Al Ittihad (الاتحاد) reported on the company in relation to contracts, ventures or leadership?
prompts.why_it_matters: The Abu Dhabi national daily is a strong record of government contracts and sovereign-backed corporate activity.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name on Al Ittihad, including the Arabic form, and read any matching business coverage.
prompts.found_when: One or more Al Ittihad articles name the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no article naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Results are dominated by unrelated items using the same words, or the search does not respond.

prompts.question: Does the company have a merchant storefront or customer reviews on Amazon.ae?
prompts.why_it_matters: Storefront pages tie a trade name behind a seller and expose fulfilment or dispute complaints from real buyers.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the Amazon.ae search box and look for a seller or storefront page tied to it.
prompts.found_when: A storefront, seller page or product listing linked to the company name is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns only unrelated third-party products with no storefront or seller link to the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Results are ambiguous because the name is a common product term, or the site blocks the search.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on Argaam UAE discussion boards or company pages with investor commentary?
prompts.why_it_matters: Investor forum chatter can reveal governance concerns or sentiment that official filings never state.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name on Argaam's UAE section and open any company page or thread that names it.
prompts.found_when: A company page or forum thread on Argaam mentions the company by name.
prompts.not_found_when: Searches return no company page or thread naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Only anonymous posts of unclear authorship match, or the Arabic name variants cannot be linked.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the DIFC Courts registry of judgments and orders?
prompts.why_it_matters: Recorded judgments, winding-up petitions and enforcement orders are hard evidence of commercial litigation.

source.name: DIFC Courts Registry of Judgments and Orders

prompts.how_to_query: Use the DIFC Courts judgments and orders keyword search with the company's full legal name.
prompts.found_when: One or more judgments or orders name the company as a party.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean keyword search returns no judgment or order naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search index is unavailable or the case records use abbreviations that cannot be matched.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC) member directory with an active licence?
prompts.why_it_matters: The DMCC directory confirms free zone licence status, so a suspended or absent entry points to a credential problem.

source.name: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC) Member Directory

prompts.how_to_query: Open the DMCC business directory and search the company's registered name.
prompts.found_when: A member record shows the company with its licence status and licensed activities.
prompts.not_found_when: The DMCC directory returns no member record for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search fails or the name matches several unrelated members.

prompts.question: Does the Dubai Land Department / RERA Trakheesi lookup show the company as a licensed developer, broker or permitted advertiser?
prompts.why_it_matters: Unlicensed brokerage or development activity is a common legal and credential risk in Dubai real estate.

source.name: Dubai Land Department (DLD) / RERA Trakheesi System

prompts.how_to_query: Open the DLD broker and real estate licence lookup and search the company or office name.
prompts.found_when: A licence or Trakheesi permit record matches the company with an office or permit number.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean lookup returns no licence or permit record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup service is down, or the company does no real estate activity so there is nothing to match.

prompts.question: Is the company registered in the Dubai South (DWC) free zone company directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A directory entry validates the free zone registration and licensed activities the company claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name in the Dubai South company directory.
prompts.found_when: A directory record lists the company as a Dubai South registered entity.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory returns no record for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory query fails or the name is too generic to isolate one record.

prompts.question: Is the company a corporate member of the Emirates Green Building Council?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership is a public sustainability credential that can corroborate or contradict green marketing claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Emirates GBC corporate industry partner page and scan the member list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the Emirates GBC corporate member listing.
prompts.not_found_when: The member listing contains no company matching the searched name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member list is image based or paginated, or the name is too generic to distinguish.

prompts.question: Do Expat.com UAE forum threads discuss the company in relation to employment, visas or landlord disputes?
prompts.why_it_matters: Employee and tenant posts often surface unpaid wages, visa problems or blacklist claims before official sources do.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name in the Expat.com UAE search and read any matching forum threads.
prompts.found_when: A forum thread mentions the company by name in a work, visa or tenancy context.
prompts.not_found_when: Searches return no thread mentioning the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Only vague references without the company name appear, or the forum search is unavailable.

prompts.question: Has Gulf News business coverage reported on the company in connection with disputes, restructuring or performance?
prompts.why_it_matters: Gulf News is a mainstream record of commercial disputes and corporate developments in the UAE.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name on Gulf News and review the business and companies results.
prompts.found_when: One or more Gulf News business articles name the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns no article naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Results are dominated by unrelated articles using the same words, or the search page will not load.

prompts.question: Is the company listed among Hub71 Abu Dhabi's accepted startups or portfolio companies?
prompts.why_it_matters: Hub71 acceptance is a public credibility signal often used in funding and incentive claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Hub71 startups directory and search the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company has a profile in the Hub71 startup directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory returns no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory cannot be filtered by name or the page fails to load.

prompts.question: Does the KHDA education directory list the company as a licensed school, university or training provider?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only KHDA licensed providers may operate education in Dubai, so absence is a credential red flag.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the KHDA education directory for the relevant provider type and scan for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A KHDA directory entry lists the company with a licence or rating.
prompts.not_found_when: The KHDA directory has no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory only covers Dubai education providers, so other company types cannot be checked.

prompts.question: Does the Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology (MoIAT) list the company for an industrial licence, ECAS certificate or Halal mark?
prompts.why_it_matters: Product certification and industrial licences are federal credentials that unregistered firms sometimes claim.

source.name: Ministry of Industry and Advanced Technology (MoIAT)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the MoIAT conformity and industrial licence lookup and search the company name.
prompts.found_when: A certificate or licence record under the company name is returned.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean MoIAT search returns no certificate or licence record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup times out, or the company holds no product certificates so no match is possible.

prompts.question: Is the company shown on Property Finder UAE as a licensed brokerage or verified agent?
prompts.why_it_matters: The portal exposes RERA and Trakheesi permit references so unlicensed agencies stand out.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name in Property Finder's brokerage directory.
prompts.found_when: A brokerage profile shows the company with a licensing or permit reference.
prompts.not_found_when: The brokerage directory returns no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns many similarly named agencies or the directory blocks the query.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Reach UAE business directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Third-party listings carry address, phone and activity data that can confirm or contradict the company's own claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name in the Reach UAE business keyword search.
prompts.found_when: A directory listing matches the company name with contact details or activities.
prompts.not_found_when: The keyword search returns no listing for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns only similarly named firms or the directory is unavailable.

prompts.question: Is the company registered in the Sharjah Airport International Free Zone (SAIF Zone) tenant directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A tenant record confirms free zone registration and the trading activity the company states.

source.name: Sharjah Airport International Free Zone (SAIF Zone) Directory

prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name in the SAIF Zone business directory.
prompts.found_when: A tenant record lists the company in SAIF Zone.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory returns no tenant record for the company.

prompts.question: Is the company recorded in the Securities and Commodities Authority (SCA) registry of public joint stock companies or licensed financial firms?
prompts.why_it_matters: SCA registration is mandatory for public companies and brokers, and the registry also carries penalties.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the SCA licensed companies register and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: An SCA register entry lists the company with a licence or public company status.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean SCA register search returns no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register query fails, or the company is of a type the SCA does not license so nothing can match.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Sharjah Media City (Shams) company directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A Shams entry confirms free zone registration for a claimed media, tech or service business.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Shams company directory and search the company name.
prompts.found_when: A directory profile lists the company as a Shams registered entity.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory returns no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search fails or the company name is too generic to isolate a profile.

prompts.question: Has Sheraa (Sharjah Entrepreneurship Center) listed the company as an incubated or funded startup?

prompts.found_when: A TDRA register entry matches the company name with an approval or licence.
prompts.not_found_when: The TDRA registers contain no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The register form requires filters that do not apply or it does not respond.

prompts.question: Has The National reported on the company in connection with operations, regulatory changes or litigation?
prompts.why_it_matters: The National covers corporate litigation and state-linked ventures that shape a company's public standing.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name on The National and read the business results.

prompts.why_it_matters: A partner profile confirms media free zone registration behind claims to be an established media business.

prompts.why_it_matters: Chamber membership is expected for licensed businesses in the emirate and supports the company's local standing.

source.name: Umm Al Quwain Chamber of Commerce and Industry

prompts.how_to_query: Search the company name in the UAQ Chamber member and directory lookup.
prompts.found_when: A chamber membership or directory record matches the company.

prompts.question: Is the company on the VARA public register of licensed virtual asset service providers, or on its public warning list?
prompts.why_it_matters: VARA registration is mandatory for crypto activity in Dubai, and the warning list flags unlicensed operators.

source.name: Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) Public Register

prompts.how_to_query: Open the VARA public register and search the company name, then check the warning list.
prompts.found_when: A VARA register entry lists the company with an authorised activity, or the warning list names it.
prompts.not_found_when: Neither the register nor the warning list contains the company name.
